title: Dick Billings visits Sheehan over the sealed Iran-Contra complaint

tellings.quote: he said there aren't two men in the world that would have answered that question that way he said my name is was Dick Billings I was the chief staff writer for the house select committee on assassinations I think I can help you out on this case

plain: A lawyer named Dan Sheehan told podcast host Jesse Michels about the 1980s, when his legal group, the Christic Institute, brought a sealed lawsuit tied to Iran-Contra, a US scandal over secret arms sales and covert funding. He says a man came to his Washington office, said only a couple of people in the world would have answered his question the way Sheehan did, and introduced himself as Dick Billings, former chief staff writer for the House committee that reinvestigated political assassinations, offering to help with the case. Sheehan tells it as how he gained an insider who could open doors to hidden government secrets.
